fields.name: wsxmr_amount
docs: wsXMR burned (8 decimals)

fields.name: xmr_amount
docs: Equivalent XMR atomic units (12 decimals)

fields.name: locked_collateral
docs: Base collateral locked for this burn

fields.name: reward_collateral
docs: Extra collateral locked as burn reward

fields.name: user_claim_commitment
docs: User's Ed25519 commitment: keccak256(compress(secret · G))

fields.name: user_public_key
docs: User's compressed Ed25519 public spend key (for Monero address derivation + slash verification)

fields.name: user_view_key
docs: User's Ed25519 public view key (x-coordinate)

fields.name: xmr_price_at_request
docs: XMR price snapshot at request time (par settlement for slashes), 1e18-scaled USD

fields.name: secret_hash
docs: Hash of LP's secret (set in propose_hash)

fields.name: lp_public_spend_key
docs: LP's Ed25519 public spend key (x-coordinate) — set at propose_hash

fields.name: lp_public_view_key
docs: LP's Ed25519 public view key (x-coordinate) — set at propose_hash

fields.name: revealed_secret
docs: LP's revealed Ed25519 secret (set by reveal_burn_secret / finalize_burn)

fields.name: deadline
docs: Deadline unix timestamp

fields.name: vault_liquidation_nonce
docs: Snapshot of vault liquidation nonce at creation

fields.name: normalized_debt_amount
docs: Normalized debt amount deducted at settlement (0 until then — debt is NOT
reduced at request time, eliminating index-shift debt inflation bugs)

fields.name: abandoned
docs: True when the LP abandoned a PROPOSED burn — the user's wsXMR remains
claimable via resolve_declined_proposal (requires userSecret reveal)

types.name: CoLPPosition
docs: A co-LP position: a user pairs wsXMR with an LP vault's idle QQQx collateral
to open a concentrated-liquidity position on Orca Whirlpools (EVM
PositionMetadata parity). The vault manager program is the position authority;
the Orca Position account is referenced by `position_address`.

fields.name: vault
docs: LP vault that supplied the collateral leg

fields.name: user
docs: User that supplied the wsXMR leg

fields.name: collateral_original
docs: Raw QQQx deployed from the vault (8 decimals)

fields.name: wsxmr_original
docs: wsXMR deployed by the user (8 decimals)

fields.name: tick_lower
docs: Lower tick of the concentrated range

fields.name: tick_upper
docs: Upper tick of the concentrated range

fields.name: liquidity
docs: Liquidity units deployed (Orca Position.liquidity)

fields.name: position_address
docs: Orca Whirlpools Position account address

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix timestamp of position creation

fields.name: nonce
docs: Nonce used in the PDA seed (global request nonce at creation)

fields.name: authority
docs: Deployer/admin pubkey (one-time router setup)

fields.name: wsxmr_mint
docs: wsXMR SPL Token 2022 mint address

fields.name: collateral_mint
docs: Collateral SPL token mint (raw QQQx, no yield wrapper)

fields.name: liquidity_router
docs: Authorized liquidity router program

fields.name: pyth_xmr_feed
docs: Pyth XMR/USD price feed account

fields.name: global_total_debt
docs: Total wsXMR debt across all vaults (8 decimals)

fields.name: global_debt_index
docs: Debt multiplier for O(1) proportional forgiveness (scaled 1e18, stored as u64).
Fixed at INITIAL_DEBT_INDEX — no buy-and-burn modifies it, but the
normalized-debt machinery is retained for EVM accounting parity.

fields.name: global_pending_collateral
docs: Pending collateral withdrawals queued in PendingReturns accounts.
Backed by the program_collateral_ata pool.

fields.name: global_pending_sol
docs: Pending SOL/lamport withdrawals queued in PendingReturns accounts

fields.name: global_bad_debt
docs: Unbacked wsXMR from liquidation shortfalls

fields.name: global_pending_burn_debt
docs: wsXMR debt currently locked in pending burn requests

fields.name: request_nonce
docs: Global nonce for request ID generation

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Explicit padding so the struct is Pod-compatible (no implicit alignment padding)

fields.name: request_id
docs: Unique request identifier (hash of initiator+lp+xmr_amount+commitment+nonce)

fields.name: initiator
docs: Who paid the griefing deposit

fields.name: recipient
docs: Destination for minted wsXMR

fields.name: lp_vault
docs: LP vault pubkey

fields.name: xmr_amount
docs: XMR atomic units (12 decimals)

fields.name: wsxmr_amount
docs: wsXMR amount (8 decimals)

fields.name: fee_amount
docs: Portion of wsxmr_amount going to LP as fee

fields.name: claim_commitment
docs: Ed25519 commitment: keccak256(compress(secret · G)) binding the user's secret

fields.name: user_public_key
docs: User's compressed Ed25519 public spend key (for Monero address derivation)

fields.name: lp_public_spend_key
docs: LP's Ed25519 public spend key (x-coordinate) — set at provide_lp_key

fields.name: lp_public_view_key
docs: LP's Ed25519 public view key (x-coordinate) — set at provide_lp_key

fields.name: lp_commitment
docs: LP's Ed25519 commitment: keccak256(compress(lp_secret · G))

fields.name: timeout
docs: Expiry unix timestamp (also reused as the LP claim-window deadline for
KeyCancelled / ExpiredReady states)

fields.name: griefing_deposit
docs: SOL lamports deposited as anti-spam

fields.name: locked_collateral
docs: Collateral shares locked as the key bond (provide_lp_key) / par lock (set_mint_ready)

fields.name: xmr_price_at_ready
docs: XMR price snapshot at set_mint_ready (par settlement), 1e18-scaled USD

fields.name: normalized_debt_amount
docs: Normalized debt amount stored for consistent accounting

fields.name: vault_mint_nonce
docs: Snapshot of vault's mint_nonce at creation (for liquidation invalidation)

fields.name: revealed_secret
docs: User's revealed Ed25519 secret (set by reveal_secret, read by finalize_mint)

fields.name: collateral_amount
docs: Pending collateral token withdrawals

fields.name: sol_amount
docs: Pending SOL (lamport) withdrawals

fields.name: lp_address
docs: LP owner of this vault

fields.name: collateral_amount
docs: Raw QQQx collateral held — TOTAL model: includes locked_collateral, so
available = collateral_amount - locked_collateral - deployed_collateral

fields.name: locked_collateral
docs: Collateral reserved for pending burns/mints (still inside collateral_amount)

fields.name: normalized_debt
docs: Normalized debt: actual_debt = normalized_debt * global_debt_index / 1e18

fields.name: pending_debt
docs: Reserved capacity for pending mints (not liquidatable)

fields.name: max_mint_bps
docs: LP-configured max single mint size in basis points (0 = no limit)

fields.name: mint_griefing_deposit
docs: SOL lamports required per mint request (anti-spam griefing deposit)

fields.name: mint_fee_bps
docs: Fee LP charges for minting (basis points, max 1000)

fields.name: burn_reward_bps
docs: Reward LP pays to incentivize burning (basis points, max 1000)

fields.name: liquidation_nonce
docs: Incremented on liquidation to invalidate all pending burns

fields.name: mint_nonce
docs: Incremented on liquidation to invalidate all pending mints

fields.name: min_burn_amount
docs: LP-configurable minimum burn amount (0 = use global default)

fields.name: active_burn_count
docs: Number of currently active (non-terminal) burn requests

fields.name: pending_mint_count
docs: Number of mints in READY state — blocks state-changing vault ops until resolved

fields.name: mint_timeout_seconds
docs: LP-configured mint request timeout in seconds (EVM mintTimeoutBlocks parity)

fields.name: burn_timeout_seconds
docs: LP-configured burn request timeout in seconds (EVM burnTimeoutBlocks parity)

fields.name: whitelisted_minters
docs: Whitelisted minters that bypass the griefing deposit (EVM whitelistedMinters parity)

fields.name: whitelisted_minter_count
docs: Number of entries in whitelisted_minters

fields.name: deployed_collateral
docs: QQQx deployed into co-LP positions (excluded from liquid balance)

fields.name: max_co_lp_range_bps
docs: LP's preferred max co-LP range width in basis points (EVM maxCoLPRangeBps parity)
